entries.subject: A false colour from three measured bands, as the HR 8799 planets have
entries.finding: No paper checked gives flux densities of this companion in three JWST bands like the NIRCam F410M, F430M and F460M that colour HR 8799's planets. A colour from other bands would not compare with those, so it is the shared neutral gray.
entries.revisitWhen: Flux densities in three bands comparable with HR 8799's are published.
